targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
	host,
	$__timeInterval(timestamp) as time,
	count()
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
AND host != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND $__adHocFilter()
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${attackTypes:sqlstring}], attackTypes), $attackTypes)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleActions:sqlstring}], ruleActions), $ruleActions)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleTags:sqlstring}], ruleTags), $ruleTags)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleMessages:sqlstring}], ruleMessages), $ruleMessages)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleID:sqlstring}], rules), $ruleID)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleData:sqlstring}], ruleData), $ruleData)
AND $__conditionalAll(hasAny([${ruleSelectors:sqlstring}], ruleSelectors), $ruleSelectors)
AND $__conditionalAll(path ILIKE '%${path}%', $path)
GROUP BY time, host
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Attack by Hostname; du=${__user.login}'
